import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react"
import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router"
import { ShieldCheck, Sparkles } from "lucide-react"
import { adminPlan } from "@/generated/admin-plan"
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"

export const Route = createFileRoute({{FIZZYX_LOGIN_ROUTE}})({
  head: () => ({ meta: [{ title: `Sign In · ${adminPlan.title}` }] }),
  component: LoginPage,
})
function LoginPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [error, setError] = useState("")
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false)
  async function submit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault(); setPending(true); setError("")
    try {
      const form = new FormData(event.currentTarget)
      const response = await fetch("/api/auth/login", { method: "POST", headers: { "content-type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ [{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_FIELD}}]: form.get("username"), [{{FIZZYX_PASSWORD_FIELD}}]: form.get("password") }) })
      if (!response.ok) return setError("Invalid credentials. Check your sign-in details and try again.")
      await navigate({ to: {{FIZZYX_AFTER_LOGIN_ROUTE}} })
    } catch {
      setError("Unable to reach the sign-in service. Try again in a moment.")
    } finally {
      setPending(false)
    }
  }
  return <main className="relative grid min-h-screen overflow-hidden bg-muted/20 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.1fr)_minmax(420px,0.9fr)]"><section className="relative hidden overflow-hidden border-r bg-primary p-12 text-primary-foreground lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:justify-between"><div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-15 [background-image:radial-gradient(circle_at_1px_1px,currentColor_1px,transparent_0)] [background-size:28px_28px]" /><div className="relative flex items-center gap-3"><span className="flex size-11 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-primary-foreground/15 ring-1 ring-primary-foreground/20"><ShieldCheck aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" /></span><div><p className="font-semibold">{adminPlan.title}</p><p className="text-sm text-primary-foreground/70">Secure administration</p></div></div><div className="relative max-w-xl space-y-5"><Badge className="border-primary-foreground/20 bg-primary-foreground/10 text-primary-foreground"><Sparkles aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" />OpenAPI-powered workspace</Badge><h1 className="text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-balance">Manage your API with clarity.</h1><p className="max-w-lg text-lg leading-relaxed text-primary-foreground/75 text-pretty">A typed, secure admin workspace generated from your OpenAPI contract.</p></div><p className="relative text-sm text-primary-foreground/60">Session credentials stay on the server.</p></section><section className="flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-8 lg:p-12"><div className="w-full max-w-md space-y-6"><div className="flex items-center gap-3 lg:hidden"><span className="flex size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground"><ShieldCheck aria-hidden="true" className="size-5" /></span><span className="font-semibold">{adminPlan.title}</span></div><Card className="shadow-xl shadow-foreground/5"><CardHeader className="space-y-2"><CardTitle className="text-2xl tracking-tight">Welcome Back</CardTitle><CardDescription>Sign in with your API account to continue.</CardDescription></CardHeader><CardContent><form method="post" className="space-y-5" onSubmit={submit}><Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="username">{{FIZZYX_USERNAME_LABEL}}</FieldLabel><Input id="username" name="username" type={{FIZZYX_USERNAME_TYPE}} autoComplete="username" spellCheck={false} required /></Field><Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="password">Password</FieldLabel><Input id="password" name="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required /></Field><div aria-live="polite">{error ? <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}</div><Button className="w-full" type="submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? "Signing In…" : "Sign In"}</Button></form></CardContent></Card><p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Protected by an HttpOnly server session.</p></div></section></main>
}
